description.purpose: A deliberately-broken variant of demo/contracts/invaract_output.yaml, kept for reference/demonstration of ContractEnforcementRule's abort behavior (see ROADMAP.md Phase 5 / docs/SPARK_ADAPTER.md). Not wired into ./dev/test — the real demo pipeline is expected to pass its real contract, not this one. Declares a 'customer_name' output field the real InvaractPlugin pipeline never produces, so verification fails deterministically.

violations.remediation: Add a 'customer_name' column (type 'string') to the output, or mark it optional in the contract if it isn't always produced.
violations.message: required field 'customer_name' is absent from the actual OUTPUT schema
